subheader: Every plan includes some practitioner accounts. Above that, the rate falls as the number grows.
lead: A practitioner is anyone patients can book. Reception staff, students on placement and owners who no longer treat patients are free.
note: The band depends on the number of practitioner accounts on the first of the month. New accounts are billed by the day from the day they are created.

bands.text: Covered by the Praxis plan. Billed only above the five it includes.
